'''SG-619''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as a [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout trooper]].

==Biography==
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], SG-619 was stationed at the [[Imperial Outpost (Dantooine)|Imperial Outpost]] on the remote [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], where he served under [[SG-567]].

On one of his scouting missions, he was joined by an Imperial agent who had previously helped SG-567 with a malfunctioning [[Droideka/Legends|droideka]]. During their patrol, they were attacked by stranded [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Scout/Legends|scouts]], but were able to kill their attackers and return safely to the outpost.
